note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Times are fictional labels. "Reciprocal" and "unilateral" are supplied configurations only — who holds which commitment; nothing states whether a commitment binds, is enforceable or valid, or whether a contract is formed.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional exchange: Party A commits to supply 40 chairs (C-101), Party B commits to pay for them (C-102); both cards are sent, cross and land at the other party, each keeping its holder. The hold shows the supplied configuration: reciprocal commitments (as supplied).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a garden-maintenance commitment between different parties; only Party A's commitment is in the supplied sequence (sent and received), so one card and one route are shown and B's rack holds no slot. The hold shows the supplied configuration: unilateral promise (as supplied).

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names, roles, references, titles and time labels, three terms, two annotations; the two receipts are supplied with one position (order to be examined) and the hold brackets the time sequence as to be examined. Standing coordinator rule item 20 (caps with the true reason). The pre-cap values are kept in LAW-0457.presets.precap.json. Each capped field was restored alone to its pre-cap value on top of the shipped preset and rendered (layout verdict per ratio): the reference 12 -> 20 makes 9:16 fail (nofit: the rack strip and routes); the title 33 -> 64, the first term label 9 -> 16 and value 20 -> 52, the second term value 12 -> 38 and the third term value 13 -> 39 each make 9:16 and 1:1 fail (nofit: cards too tall for the racks, hands cannot reach); the second term label 10 -> 18 makes 1:1 fail (nofit, rackTall); the two grouped receipt time labels 26 -> 40 make 9:16 and 1:1 fail (nofit, figures pushed outside); the first annotation 30 -> 53 makes 1:1 fail (the note cannot be placed). With every capped field restored, all three ratios fail. Every capped value stays longer than its baseline counterpart (reference 12 vs 5, title 33 vs 20, term labels 9 vs 4 and 10 vs 8, term values 20 vs 17 and 12 vs 2, receipt time labels 26 vs 24; the third term and the annotation have no baseline counterpart); every count is kept. Shipped: 16.1 px text in each ratio; heads 88.2 px (16:9), 72.6 px (9:16), 73.0 px (1:1), both people at the hold (rendered).
